title: Current-State Terminology Normalisation Audit
purpose: Classify active command, documentation, validator, proof, and agent-facing terminology after the v2-foundation baseline so current-state aliases can be added without weakening historical compatibility or assurance evidence.

executionRecommendations.summary: Add Make help output and current-state aliases for setup, foundation validation, coverage validation, assurance validation, and evidence validation while retaining compatibility targets.
Make the bounded local Sonar zero-open-issue quality gate explicit in proof output, evidence artefacts, and validators without broad readiness claims.
